Subject: Fraudulent withdrawals from the Accounts of EPFO through fake cheques-
instructions to avoid fraudulent payment- reg.

CORRIGENDUM

Sir

This is with reference to office circular no. Bkg./Fraud/05/39906 dated 20.12.2011
posted at St.No. 460 of the official website of the organization under Office Orders & Circulars for
the year 2011-12 to avoid fraudulent withdrawals.

2. Under sub-para C of para 5 of circular dated 20.12.2011 the sentence

“on receipt of Demand Drafts/Banker’s cheques for the like amount (involved in the cheque), the
same shall be dispatched to the member/nominee of the deceased with a forwarding letter"

shall be substituted and read as

“on receipt of Demand Drafts/Banker’s cheques for the like amount (involved in the cheque), the
same shall be dispatched to the bank where the member/nominee of the deceased maintain his/her
bank account with a forwarding letter”

Yours faithfully,

are

(RAJESH BANSAL)
